scope: Every original proposed span, including exact correspondences and depth/boundary/member recasts; original IDs and occurrence ranges preserved. Exact excludes original ID renaming but includes depth, strings and both occurrence ranges.

dispositions.independent_disposition: Inferential connective concluding this glass-of-water argument.
Karma in the opening qualification of the three beings; can possessive frame left unbanked.
Opening three kinds of beings, before GMR’s later repeated participants.
Three in the opening named group.
Moist material in the first glass, not an appearance predicate.
Conjunction between wet and flowing.
Second quality of the material, attested HGM flowing.
First glass in the opening observation scenario.
Filling/quantity adjective in phor pa gang; not the relative pronoun homograph.

cig car expresses simultaneity of the opening observation; together is the temporal adverbial exponent. Retain the shorter lexical adverb rather than absorb du into a new phrase. HGM cig car and cig car du records distinguish the related forms.
Opening act of looking; supplied sit down stays unwrapped.
Abbreviated tshad ma in the claim about equivalent valid cognition.
Equality predicate of those valid perceptions.
Lexical certainty adverb; the copular true is not captured.
Necessity predicate in the opening thesis.
Standalone Tibetan negative particle, even though English not is also a separate word.
Conditional after the second dgos; GMR’s they did is not independently banked.
Glass in the hypothetical counterexample after If they did.
First gnas is nominal: gnas kyi blos, a conception of the water as a dwelling place.

gnas kyi blos describes conceiving the contents as a residence; blos is the inflected mind/conception noun and locally becomes think. HGM blo supports think, while exact blos has intent; C05:250 repeats gnas kyi blos and says thinks of this same water as a place to stay. Do not split agentive -s or treat the latter passage as proof beyond the shared cognitive relation.

gnas shing is the residence verb of the creature occupying the glass. GMR first says a creature living in water at E[418:424]; the infinitive to live expands nominal place, and the middle living at E[537:543] repeats the glass explanation. Only this first verbal residence occurrence is selected.
Ordinary eye consciousness, the first of three mig shes in Tibetan.
Normal visual consciousness in imperceptible to normal visual consciousness.
Eye/visual member within normal visual consciousness.
Consciousness member inside that first parent.
First Tibetan organisms, rendered first microscopic organisms; later little beings is GMR’s second rendering and stays unwrapped.
First smallness qualifier; later little is the same qualifier repeated by GMR.
Microscopic organisms’ own visual consciousness after see it with their own, not normal consciousness or the ocean clause.
Eye/visual member inside the organisms’ own consciousness parent.
Consciousness member inside the second parent.

The first rgya mtsho names the habitat of the second organisms and selects ocean at E[749:754]. Take the narrower nominal stem from the English proposal; the attached genitive is not asserted to mean ocean.

nang denotes the ocean interior, locally rendered depths. HGM nang explicitly attests depths and the source's following na licenses in separately. The English proposal's claim that depths is merely supplied is rejected on this source relation and HGM field.
na is the locative particle following ocean-interior nang and selects in at E[728:730], after the ocean organisms' living. It is distinct from the conditional na at W[154:156] and the cup's du.

gnas pa is the ocean organisms' residence predicate at W[352:359], rendered living at E[721:727]. Remove the English proposal's attached genitive 'i; the middle living belongs to the cup restatement and is skipped.
Second Tibetan organisms, those living in the ocean.
Smallness qualifier of the ocean organisms.
Ocean organisms’ eye consciousness, following Then too; English places this before its Tibetan possessors.
Eye/visual member of ocean organisms’ consciousness.
Consciousness member inside the ocean parent.
Even/also applying to the ocean organisms’ consciousness, rendered Then too.
The second rgya mtsho names the object whose extent would be known, rendered sea at E[824:827]. Tighten off the genitive 'i while preserving this second source occurrence.

This second tshad measures the sea as a whole, distinct from the opening abbreviated pramana. HGM tshad explicitly includes entire extent, and rgya mtsho'i tshad la concerns the measure of the sea, so GMR's full entire extent is a defensible local rendering of the single measure noun. Preserve that attested phrase; entire is not dismissed merely because English writes it separately.
Object relation of validity towards the sea’s extent.

The second tshad mar is the ocean-consciousness validity predicate and maps valid perception at E[774:790]. The first tshad mar has a distributed same-way recast and must not jump to this later explicit occurrence. The bound -r remains with the inflected lexical unit.
Second consequent dgos pa concerns the ocean consciousness and owns have to at E[761:768]. would is hypothetical English framing, and the following be is separately licensed by 'gro.
Asura compound retained whole, with no false literal god/not member.
Indefinite selection of near-gods; supplied kinds of stays unwrapped.
mtshon cha is the weapons noun in the near-god consequence. Retaining weapons asserts this clear noun correspondence, not the disputed direction of the entire weapons/cupful appearance relation.
phor is the vessel noun in phor gang, attested by HGM as glasses and explicitly present at E[893:900]. No member or parent claims gang means of water; the full relation remains unresolved.
snang is the appearance/perception predicate in the near-god clause and GMR realizes it as see at E[878:881]. Earlier see occurrences belong to the cup-organism expansion and are not this predicate.
Final dgos pa expresses the near-god consequence's necessity, realized by have to at E[870:877]. It cannot resolve to either earlier cup or ocean modal, and supplied would is excluded.

la sogs pa is the closing enumeration phrase, rendered and on and on. Keep the tighter Tibetan boundary without the following genitive 'i and no supplied problem noun; d3 records the full closing phrase rather than invent a lexical noun compound.
Consequences/problems ending the argument; many is not banked on yod.
